plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Nursing – Practical, Intermediate Technical Certificate' program page (Major Code: 4411T), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/nursing-department/nursing-practical/nursing-practical-intermediate-technical-certificate . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Intermediate Technical Certificate (page title 'Nursing – Practical, Intermediate Technical Certificate'; the CSI majors index confirms the 42-46-credit ITC award). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 42, the catalog's published minimum ('Total Credit Hours: 42-46'; the page also prints 'Total Credit Hours: 46'). Modeled honestly per corpus convention: the BIOL 227 AND BIOL 228 (8 cr) OR BIOL 105 (4 cr) admission requirement is modeled at 4 credits (BIOL 105, minimum-credit path); the BIOL 227+228 path yields the catalog's 46-credit total. Structure: the catalog publishes this plan as a flat 'Required Courses' list with no semester-by-semester sequence, and states all admission courses must be completed prior to entrance; modeled as semester 1 'Pre-Admission Requirements' (15 cr) + semester 2 'Professional Phase' (27 cr, the NURP block, whose internal semester sequencing the catalog does not publish). Program admission also requires current CNA certification (not a course in this plan). Graduates earn IV Therapy Certification and are eligible for the NCLEX-PN. Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
